title.en: 4M Studio — iOS apps made with care
title.zh: 4M Studio — 用心打磨的 iOS 应用

description.en: 4M Studio is an independent iOS app studio behind AvatarTracker, StoryReel, MeetLog, QQNest, Wearly and WorthView — small, private apps for iPhone.
description.zh: 4M Studio 是一家独立 iOS 应用工作室，作品包括随影、故事卷轴、会记、鹊巢、衣见和净览——小而精、注重隐私的 iPhone 应用。

mm_label.en: MieMie, AvatarTracker's character. She follows your pointer; press to play a gesture.
mm_label.zh: 随影的角色 MieMie。她会跟着你的鼠标看；点一下她会做动作。

mm_hint.en: Move your mouse — she's watching. Click her for a move.
mm_hint.zh: 动动鼠标，她在看着你。点她一下试试。

mm_hint_touch.en: Touch anywhere — she looks. Tap her for a move.
mm_hint_touch.zh: 点屏幕任意位置，她会看过去；点她一下试试。

apps_title.zh:
小小的应用，
大大的用心。

apps_lede.en: Every 4M app starts the same way: one small problem, solved properly, with an interface you don't have to think about.
apps_lede.zh: 每个 4M 应用都从同一件事开始：把一个小问题认真解决好，界面简单到你不用去想。

studio_lede.en: 4M Studio is an independent iOS studio. We don't chase feature lists or funding rounds — we ship a handful of apps, maintain them properly, and answer our own support email.
studio_lede.zh: 4M Studio 是一家独立 iOS 工作室。我们不追逐功能清单，也不追逐融资——只做少数几款应用，认真维护，亲自回复每一封用户邮件。

studio_body.en: Everything we make follows the same rules: it should open instantly, keep your data on your device, and never ask you to watch an ad. If a feature can't be made simple, it doesn't ship.
studio_body.zh: 我们做的每样东西都遵循同样的规则：秒开、数据留在你的设备上、永远不让你看广告。一个功能如果做不到简单，就不上线。

v1_b.en: One screen, one job. We cut until only the useful part is left.
v1_b.zh: 一屏一事，删到只剩真正有用的部分。

v2_b.en: Apps that earn their place on your Home Screen, not your attention.
v2_b.zh: 值得留在你主屏幕上的应用，而不是抢夺你注意力的应用。

v3_b.en: Designed for the iPhone in your hand — gestures, widgets, all of it.
v3_b.zh: 为你手中的 iPhone 而设计——手势、小组件，一应俱全。

v4_b.en: Updated for every iOS release. No abandoned apps, no dead links.
v4_b.zh: 跟进每一次 iOS 更新，不弃坑，不留死链。

updates_title.zh:
我们最近
在忙些什么。

contact_title.zh:
遇到问题？
有想法？来打个招呼。

contact_lede.en: Support emails come straight to the people who wrote the code. We reply to everything, usually within a day.
contact_lede.zh: 支持邮件会直接送到写代码的人手里。每封都会回复，通常在一天之内。

footer_blurb.en: An independent iOS studio making small, private, carefully built apps.
footer_blurb.zh: 一家独立 iOS 工作室，专注打造小而精、注重隐私的应用。

footer_made.en: Made in Swift · Designed for iPhone
footer_made.zh: Swift 打造 · 为 iPhone 设计

p_features_t.en:
Built for one job,
done properly.
p_features_t.zh:
专注一件事，
把它做好。

p_support_b.en: Bug reports, feature ideas and privacy questions all go to the same inbox, read by the people who build {app}.
p_support_b.zh: 问题反馈、功能建议和隐私疑问都发到同一个邮箱，由开发 {app} 的人亲自阅读。

nf_b.en: The link may be old, or the page may have moved. Everything we make is one click away.
nf_b.zh: 链接可能已过期，或页面已经搬家。我们的所有作品都在首页。

privacy_desc.en: Privacy policy for {app}, an iOS app by 4M Studio.
privacy_desc.zh: {app} 的隐私政策——4M Studio 出品的 iOS 应用。

terms_desc.en: Terms of use for the 4M Studio website and iOS apps.
terms_desc.zh: 4M Studio 网站及 iOS 应用的使用条款。

pi_lede.en: How every 4M Studio app treats your data — and where to find each app's full policy.
pi_lede.zh: 4M Studio 的每一款应用如何对待你的数据，以及各应用完整隐私政策的入口。

pi_1.en: Your data stays on your device unless an app clearly says otherwise.
pi_1.zh: 除非应用明确说明，你的数据都只保存在你的设备上。

pi_2.en: No ads, no third-party trackers, no analytics SDKs.
pi_2.zh: 没有广告，没有第三方追踪器，没有统计分析 SDK。

pi_3.en: We never sell or rent your data, and never link it across apps.
pi_3.zh: 我们绝不出售或出租你的数据，也不会跨应用关联数据。

pi_4.en: No account needed, except where a connection requires one.
pi_4.zh: 无需注册账号（除非某项连接功能必须如此）。

pi_per_app_b.en: Each app does different things, so each has its own policy that says exactly what it accesses and why.
pi_per_app_b.zh: 每款应用的功能不同，因此各有一份独立的隐私政策，写明它具体会访问什么、为什么。

pi_contact.en: Questions about privacy in any of our apps:
pi_contact.zh: 对任何一款应用的隐私有疑问，请联系：
